sources.title: mdeberta-v3-base by microsoft, Fill Mask | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, mdeberta-v3-base runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of fill mask data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.

sources.title: AI Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry Models
sources.snippet: The mDeBERTa V3 base model comes with 12 layers and a hidden size of 768. It has 86M backbone parameters with a vocabulary containing 250K tokens which introduces 190M parameters in the Embedding layer.
